title: Designing Transformational Games to Support Socio-ethical Reasoning about Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image generations for occupational prompts (e.g., 'doctor', 'nurse', 'executive') to identify single-gender default representations and occupational stereotypes.

Analyzing text-to-image outputs for racial homogenization (e.g., defaulting to White subjects) and harmful stereotypical associations (e.g., associating people of color with violence) in response to general prompts.
Evaluating text-to-image model outputs through user-generated constraint-based prompts that explicitly attempt to represent people with disabilities.
Evaluating text-to-image model outputs through user-generated constraint-based prompts aimed at producing age-diverse representations.
